snippet.title: Toddlers Shake it for Android
snippet.description:
Ever wanted to shoot your friends into space? You can! with Toddlers!

How to shoot Toddlers into space: 
Step 1: Shake your phone 
Step 2: Watch Toddler fly up 
Step 3: Tilt your phone left and right to collect extra air-time 
Step 4: Have a lot of fun! 

Toddlers is a casual and fun game for all ages, shoot the Toddler version of your friends into space, and possibly get them abducted!  Unlock extra's,  hit combo's in the Star mini-game,  and much more!
